authority_es: Orden explícita del autor: ficha con receta de cada autor y nuestra receta; canonizar y subir a TALON_11_2026 en Drive y al repositorio pre-designed-logits-operators.
authority_en: Explicit author instruction: record author recipes alongside our effective recipes; canonize and preserve in the named Drive folder and repository.

talon_mass_right.author: Facundo Firmenich
talon_mass_right.es: Receta propia del autor conservada íntegra: T externa0,85, masa0,92, strength0,7, mediana/MAD, tanh, rama right y protección externa. Sin K/P externos ni QAS.
talon_mass_right.en: Author's sealed TALON recipe preserved: external T0.85, mass0.92, strength0.7, median/MAD, tanh, right branch, outer guard; no external K/P or QAS.

baseline_t100.author: identity control
baseline_t100.es: Único baseline T1. Es control de la comparación, no una temperatura universalmente óptima ni un control que aísle por sí solo el efecto de TALON de T0,85.
baseline_t100.en: One T1 baseline; a comparison control, not a universal optimum or a temperature-matched causal isolation of TALON.

min_k.author: Yuanhao Ding et al.

author_recipe.selected_authority: official README Run Paper Inference Experiments

min_k.es: τ3/T1 procede expresamente del README de los autores. La diferencia con constructorτ2 y CLI sin argumentos T4 no lo convierte en una invención nuestra. Se fija el comando documentado, no defaults accidentales.
min_k.en: Tau3/T1 is explicitly prescribed by the authors' README. Constructor tau2 and bare CLI T4 are distinct artifacts; the documented reproduction command is the authority.

top_h.author: Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo, Seyedarmin Azizi, Souvik Kundu, Massoud Pedram

comparison_recipe.implementation_identity: historical HF5.16.1 TopHLogitsWarper; not silently relabeled as raw author code

top_h.es: Valores del constructor autoral. La implementación histórica HF5.16.1 sigue identificada como tal; no se presupone equivalencia bit a bit con el código autoral. El bucle y dispositivo del código original requieren prueba de borde antes de portarlo. No se sustituye en silencio.
top_h.en: Author constructor parameters retained. Historical HF5.16.1 remains explicitly identified; raw author-code equivalence is not assumed. Boundary/device admission precedes any implementation replacement.

min_p.author: Minh Nhat Nguyen et al.

author_recipe.temperature: paper evaluates a range, including1; no unique mandatory T
author_recipe.pipeline: temperature before relative probability cutoff; standalone truncator

min_p.es: p0,10 está dentro de la recomendación0,05–0,10 de sus autores. T1 conserva nuestro panel y pertenece a sus evaluaciones; no se impone T0,85 de TALON. Sin Top-P adicional tomado de un ejemplo ilustrativo.
min_p.en: p0.10 lies within the authors' recommended0.05–0.10 range. T1 is an evaluated setting, not TALON's T0.85. No unrelated top-p filter is inherited from an illustrative snippet.

p_less.author: Runyan Tan, Shuang Wu, Phillip Howard
p_less.es: Variante original p_less_decode; no norm ni affine. Umbral sin hiperparámetros. La temperatura se aplica una sola vez antes de formar probabilidades.
p_less.en: Original p_less_decode, not norm or affine. Hyperparameter-free cutoff; temperature applied once before probabilities.

top_nsigma.author: Chenxia Tang, Jianchun Liu, Hongli Xu, Liusheng Huang

author_recipe.selected_authority: ACL2025 paper default recommendation, sections4.2 and appendixD

top_nsigma.es: n1 es el default recomendado por sus autores. σ conserva torch.std con corrección1. Se aplica antes de truncadores que contaminen la desviación; no se mezcla con K/P externos.
top_nsigma.en: n1 is the paper-recommended default. Preserve torch.std correction1 and apply before other truncators; no external K/P stack.

eta_sampling.author: John Hewitt, Christopher D. Manning, Percy Liang

author_recipe.selected_authority: authors' human-evaluation generation records and GPT2-large repetition recipe

eta_sampling.es: Se transporta sin ajuste la receta autoral de evaluación humana ε0,0006/T1/K0/P1. No es un default universal para todos los modelos; el 0,0009 usado en otros papers comparativos no se atribuye a Hewitt et al. No cambiar según nuestros resultados.
eta_sampling.en: Transport the original authors' human-evaluation epsilon0.0006/T1/K0/P1 recipe without retuning. Not a universal all-model optimum; do not misattribute another paper's0.0009 comparator setting to these authors.

mirostat_original.author: Sourya Basu, Govardana Sachitanandam Ramachandran, Nitish Shirish Keskar, Lav R. Varshney

author_recipe.variant: original estimate-s adaptive-top-k algorithm, not Mirostat2
author_recipe.temperature: no extra scaling in original script

comparison_recipe.vocabulary_size: actual model output vocabulary N, from paper Algorithm1; replaces GPT2-demo constant50000, not outcome-tuned
comparison_recipe.state_reset: mu=6 once per fresh prompt/seed, not per token

mirostat_original.es: Original autoral: τ3bits, learning_rate1, μ0=6 y100 pares para estimar s en el script. Se exige feedback del token realmente muestreado. No sustituir por Mirostat2, por defaults de terceros τ5/η0,1 ni por el comparador sin feedback del repo Min-K. N se obtiene del modelo como en el algoritmo general del paper; se declara la adaptación del demo GPT2.
mirostat_original.en: Original author recipe: tau3bits, learning_rate1, mu0=6 and100 rank pairs in the script. Update using the actual sampled token. No substitution by Mirostat2, downstream tau5/eta0.1 defaults or Min-K's stateless comparator. N is the model vocabulary as in the paper's general algorithm; the GPT2-demo adaptation is explicit.

dola.author: Yung-Sung Chuang et al.

author_recipe.layers: model-depth-specific premature pool plus mature final layer

comparison_recipe.dola_layers: low; exact supported-model mapping must be recorded
comparison_recipe.time_adjudication: paired final and on-time; not generation kill
comparison_recipe.reference_membership: freeze per actual campaign; never retroactively add new comparators

dola.es: Un perfil greedy con plausibilidad0,1 y repetición1,2. La lista de capas depende de arquitectura/profundidad: no importar sin validar la lista de Llama a Qwen/Granite. T y P de muestreo son inactivos en greedy. El 110% es criterio de nuestra evaluación, no parámetro de los autores.
dola.en: One greedy profile with relative_top0.1 and repetition1.2. Record model-specific layer mapping; no unvalidated Llama-layer transfer. Sampling T/P inactive in greedy.110% is our evaluation rule, not an author parameter.

ees.author: Xiaodong Cai et al.

author_recipe.rule: camera-ready first crossing: retain prefix before first normalized-entropy < cumulative-mass violation
author_recipe.release_status: official README says public code is earlier and camera-ready experimental code is not synchronized

ees.es: Se documenta, pero no se inventa una receta ejecutable: el README autoral avisa de que el código público no está sincronizado con la versión final. No incluirlo ni asignarle resultados hasta resolver esa correspondencia.
ees.en: Documented, not silently admitted: the authors explicitly state that public code predates camera-ready experiments. No executable parity or results are claimed.

policy.author_recipes: Prefer the authors' explicit reproduction command, then paper task recipe, then constructor defaults. Preserve documented conflicts; never invent a universal default.
policy.no_retuning: No choice based on this study's test outcomes. Fixed author-native recipe, with declared cross-model transport rather than outcome calibration.
policy.no_silent_mutation: Version changes require explicit author direction, new canon id, changed-field record and new hashes. Preserve predecessor bytes and old outcome jurisdictions.
policy.no_hidden_filters: Disable inherited external top-k/top-p for TALON and identity baseline; do not stack them onto rivals unless their chosen documented method needs them. Native Top-H top_n and adaptive Mirostat k are not external K50.
policy.no_double_temperature: Exactly one active temperature application per sampled profile; never import TALON0.85 into foreign comparator recipes.

termination.resource_limits: Model context, provider limits and declared campaign budget remain finite. Record censored outputs without inventing final answers.

policy.comparison: Per-model/item/seed/profile/precision/backend jurisdiction, paired wins/ties/losses and bidirectional rescues. Greedy repeats are not independent content samples.
policy.hardware_and_precision: Fixed in each visible run card and matched panel; no model, weight format, compute dtype, prompt set or hardware changes authorized by this recipe document.
policy.qas_z_router: No automatic inclusion; TALON-only paper contribution remains. Separate follow-up design may add ablations with explicit authority.
policy.execution_gate: Recipe values frozen does not assert implementation parity. Validate backend, record actual effective values and confirm guard before any new model run.
policy.runtime_integration: Companion guard is implemented and tested as a standalone preflight; no existing provider campaign is modified or launched here.

corrections.before: registered experimental profile, not universal author default
corrections.after: explicit author README reproduction recipe tau3/T1

corrections.before: not in current frozen control list
corrections.after: author-derived recipes canonized; runtime admission remains explicit
corrections.numeric_change: new profiles, not rewriting old outcomes

corrections.after: original stateful author algorithm identified and pinned
author-declared release mismatch recorded; not admitted

public_payload: Scientific recipe card only; no local paths, account emails, credentials, private Drive object ids or session metadata.
